create_make_biclusters: create a synthetic bicluster dataset using make_biclusters with shape and n_clusters parameters
build_spectral_coclustering_model: build a SpectralCoclustering model with n_clusters and fit it on shuffled data
test_consensus_score: test biclustering accuracy by computing consensus_score against ground truth labels
summarize_model_biclusters: summarize fitted bicluster results by accessing model.biclusters_ and rearranging data
run_matshow_visualization: run matshow visualization to display original, shuffled, and biclustered matrices
